description: Source code implementing 'last-modified' command in Git, involving commit history analysis, diff processing, and path tracking.

classes.name: last_modified_entry
classes.description: Represents a tracked path with associated object ID and bloom filter key.

classes.name: last_modified
classes.description: Holds data structures and state for computing last modification times across commits.

classes.name: last_modified_callback_data
classes.description: Data passed to diff callbacks, linking last_modified context with specific commits.

methods.name: last_modified_entry_hashcmp
methods.description: Compares two last_modified_entry objects based on their paths.

methods.name: active_paths_for
methods.description: Retrieves or allocates the bitmap of active paths for a given commit.

methods.name: active_paths_free
methods.description: Frees the bitmap of active paths for a given commit.

methods.name: last_modified_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with last_modified structure.

methods.name: add_path_from_diff
methods.description: Callback to add paths from diff output into last_modified data.

methods.name: populate_paths_from_revs
methods.description: Populates all_paths with paths from the specified revisions.

methods.name: last_modified_emit
methods.description: Outputs the last modification info for a path and commit.

methods.name: mark_path
methods.description: Marks a path as changed if it matches the specified object ID.

methods.name: last_modified_diff
methods.description: Processes diff output to identify changed paths.

methods.name: pass_to_parent
methods.description: Transfers active path bits from child to parent commit.

methods.name: maybe_changed_path
methods.description: Determines if a path may have changed based on bloom filters.

methods.name: process_parent
methods.description: Processes a parent commit during traversal, diffing and propagating path info.

methods.name: last_modified_run
methods.description: Main algorithm to compute last modification times across commit history.

methods.name: last_modified_init
methods.description: Initializes last_modified structure with repository data and paths.

methods.name: cmd_last_modified
methods.description: Command handler for 'git last-modified', parsing options, initializing, and executing the algorithm.
